notes: Consumers must pin to this tag, not master. Fetch with: npm run fetch-cards. Corpus includes System Gateway → System Update 2021 → Midnight Sun (supported) → Parhelion (in-progress; Tunnel Vision / Nanuq on v0.51.0). If the GitHub tag is unavailable, set CARDS_DATA_ROOT to a local checkout of netrunner-cards-data (or place it as a sibling ../netrunner-cards-data).
